text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on modeling pollinator (bee) community responses to two bioenergy-driven land-use scenarios. While it uses land cover as an input and models future changes in land cover under those scenarios, its primary objective is ecological—assessing impacts on bee abundance, diversity, and composition—not predicting or simulating land use/land cover (LULC) change itself. The LULC changes are assumed exogenously (600,000 ha of marginal land converted based on policy scenarios), not modeled as the central output. Furthermore, the study is regional (Lower Michigan, USA), not national-scale, failing the explicit national-scale spatial implementation criterion. It also lacks quantitative LULC accuracy metrics or mapped LULC projections as primary outputs; instead, it maps pollinator responses. Thus, it meets exclusion criteria: local/regional scale focus and species-specific/ecological focus unrelated to LULC prediction as a primary goal.)
